Ask a safari specialist
Can I change a published itinerary?

Yes. The journeys are starting points. We can discuss changes to your route, nights, accommodation and activities before preparing a personal quotation.

What is the difference between midrange and comfort?

Midrange focuses on practical, welcoming stays and thoughtful value. Comfort offers a balance of location, hospitality and restful accommodation. The actual lodges and camps are confirmed for your dates in your quotation.

Can I combine safari with Zanzibar?

Yes. Share how long you want on safari and at the beach. We can discuss stays, flights, transfers and excursions as part of your itinerary.

What determines my safari price?

Travel dates, group size, length of stay, accommodation and optional activities all influence your quotation. Published prices apply to the existing itinerary; changes are quoted by the team.

What should I pack?

Comfortable clothing, suitable footwear, sun protection and your personal essentials are a useful start. Ask the team for a packing list suited to your safari or mountain itinerary.

Where do I check entry and travel requirements?

Verify current passport, visa, health and insurance requirements with the relevant official authorities before travelling. Our team can help point you towards the information you need.

How do I book?

Send your ideas through our planner, WhatsApp or email. We’ll discuss the details, provide a quotation and share applicable booking terms before confirmation.
